releases.notes:
## UPDATING TO THIS VERSION WILL RESET YOUR SKILL TREES
- Changed namespace to "stronger_skill_tree"
- Added reset button for the combat tree
- Fixed forge not loading
- Rewrote the block tag system to ensure better compatibility
- Rewrote xp curves (they still need around the same total of xp to max)
- Added README.md
- Uploaded project to Github
- Added compatibility for future mining/combat/foraging xp enchantments
- Renamed wood chopping to foraging
- Rewrote xp files for mining. you now only get xp from ores, but modded ores too
- rewrote xp sources for combat. you now get xp from dropped xp.
- Changed anti farming for combat to from 15 mobs to 25 mobs per chunk per 5 mins
